mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3+ months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 150k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS exceeds 150k (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction starts and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals robust aggregate demand, which boosts corporate revenue expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS rise simultaneously (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 105.0 for two consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO remains below 105.0 for two months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPI inflation rate above 2.5% year-over-year, combined with a stable federal funds rate, signals persistent inflationary pressure that may trigger a monetary tightening cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with delayed policy response
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY and FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.25% (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below its 12-month moving average, combined with a rising unemployment rate, signals weakening consumer demand and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when RSAFS < 12-month MA and UNRATE > 5.4% (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 5.6% within a single month signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer confidence and corporate hiring expectations, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE exceeds 5.6% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized rate, combined with declining residential construction starts, signals a weakening economy, which triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 < 1.0% annualized and HOUST < 1060.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
